issue_request: Published/Persuasive Security WG issue asking for a security.html section describing five security/privacy treatment buckets, category assignments for all FHIR resources, and a resource-header display control like FMM that links back to the security discussion.

Jira then cites 116321853ea87df5239ffc93f4e52f6aefb862e8, which added the source/fhir.ini security-categorization map, Resource List Security Category tab hook, security-category extension definition, and publisher/tooling support.
additional_context: Later category-family issues refined wording and presentation without reversing FHIR-19302: FHIR-20002 added/refined the Resource List link, dominant-category wording, and No Dominant Category heading and is already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-20533 aligned Individual Sensitive narrative; FHIR-54173 confirms the not-classified code remains valid while the Extension Pack display is No Dominant Category. Zulip context points back to GF#19302 and Confluence refs found no conflicting FHIR-19302 record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current combined branch still has the security/privacy category section in source/security.html, the Security Category tab and generated hook in source/resourcelist.html, active source/fhir.ini security-categorization entries for every active resource, and structuredefinition-security-category extensions on every active resource StructureDefinition source. CI output renders the Security Category header value on resource pages.
